Details

The Barcapel Foundation provides financial assistance mainly to organisations that have Registered Charitable Status. The three priority areas of funding are:

  • Health, specifically looking at mental health and complimentary medicine
  • Heritage, specifically looking at the built environment and cultural heritage.
  • Youth, which focuses on all aspects of children and young people, however focused more on those from socially and financially disadvantaged backgrounds.

Premium information is available exclusively to SCVO members and supporters

Who can apply

The foundation awards grants predominantly, but not exclusively, to charities operating in Scotland. The Barcapel Foundation provides financial assistance mainly to organisations that have Registered Charitable Status and are recognised as such by OSCR, but may on occasion make awards to non registered organisations and individuals who have charitable aims.

When to apply

Apply at any time. The board meets twice a year, usually in May/June and November.

Next deadline is Monday, 5th October, 2026

Next deadline: 5 Oct 2026

How to apply

Download the application form from the Foundation's website and submit via email attaching a covering letter & a copy of your annual accounts.
